notes: Caption styling for the overlay: character edge style (None, Drop shadow, Raised, Depressed, Outline) and a Text background slider, in the right-click menu
The Outline style now draws a real black rim — it was one pixel wide against captions many times that size, so it read as slightly bolder text
The Caption Style menu now opens on your saved settings, instead of always showing 0% and the default style
A setting that happened to match the saved value is no longer dropped in silence, so options no longer need moving away and back before they take
